PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Filters signal markers on your HUD (encounters, cargo drops, Jump Signatures): show, hide, nearby only, or delete.
PluginData.Description:
Filters the game's signal markers: Unidentified Signal, Unknown Signal, Strong Unknown Signal and Jump Signature. For each kind, choose Show, Hide (off the HUD, still in the G list) or Nearby only (on the HUD only within a distance you set). Delete all and Keep newest permanently delete those markers from your GPS list, using the G menu's own Delete request. Nothing else is ever touched: not your own GPS, Body Location, contracts or mod markers. Only sends the G menu's own requests, at most five a second.
Quick start: 1. Type /skies in chat. 2. Every kind (Unidentified, Unknown, Strong Unknown, Jump Signature) starts on Show. Pick Hide or Nearby only, and set the distance. 3. Or use chat, e.g. /skies all hide or /skies strong nearby 20.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Quiet%20Skies Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
